subject: Contract renewal & billing migration to marketplace — RetailCo
messages:
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: aisha.morton@retailco.com
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Contract renewal & billing migration to marketplace — RetailCo

Hi Aisha,

Hope you're well. RetailCo's renewal is coming up on 2026-12-14 and I wanted to propose migrating your invoicing to the AWS Marketplace for the renewal. That path simplifies procurement, centralizes invoicing, and allows you to consolidate multiple teams' spend under your Marketplace agreement.

Key highlights:
- Single invoice with your AWS billing
- Simplified procurement approvals (no separate vendor PO)
- Option for co-sell incentives (if applicable)

Would you be open to a 20-minute call next week to run through the tradeoffs and pick an approach? I attached a one-pager that outlines timelines and required PO/entitlement changes.

Attaching: migration-one-pager.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: aisha.morton@retailco.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@retailco.com
Date: 2026-11-04T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contract renewal & billing migration to marketplace — RetailCo

Hi Karthik,

Thanks — appreciate the heads up. A few quick questions before we book time:
- Will pricing/discounts change if we move to Marketplace?
- How do committed terms map to Marketplace SKUs? We need predictable spend for forecasting.
- Any changes to tax/withholding treatment?
- Who signs the new contract — Redwood or AWS reseller?

I've attached our internal PO draft for the renewal (PO_renewal_v2.pdf). Finance wants to understand cadence (monthly/annual) and any impact to our internal revenue recognition.

Can your sales ops or billing team provide a short example invoice and the steps required on our side?

Aisha Morton
Senior Procurement Manager, RetailCo
aisha.morton@retailco.com
Attaching: PO_renewal_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: aisha.morton@retailco.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-06T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Contract renewal & billing migration to marketplace — RetailCo

Hi Aisha — thanks for the detail and the PO.

Short answers up front:
- Pricing: list price stays the same; discount treatment can be preserved via a marketplace listing price that reflects the net you expect. We'll propose a marketplace quote that matches your committed pricing.
- Committed terms: we'll map your current commitment to a Marketplace listing (we'll provide SKU-level mapping in the worksheet).
- Tax: Marketplace invoices flow through AWS billing; tax handling depends on your entity and AWS settings — we'll surface that in the invoice example.
- Signatory: Redwood signs the underlying contract; the billing path will be via AWS Marketplace. We'll provide the DocuSign link and an example invoice.

Proposed next steps (fast track):
1) Quick 20-min call to confirm SKUs and cadence — propose Tues 11/9 10:00 PT.
2) We'll provide a Marketplace transition worksheet and a draft marketplace quote (attached).
3) You review with finance + procurement; we send DocuSign for the marketplace path.
4) Target switch date: 2026-11-30 (billing moves to AWS Marketplace for the 12/14 renewal).

Attaching: marketplace-transition-worksheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/82734/DEAL-2026-3479
DocuSign (draft): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-retailco

Would Tuesday work? If not, propose two times and we'll adjust.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-08T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Contract renewal & billing migration to marketplace — RetailCo (internal)

Karthik / Rachel,

Quick strategy note before the call: AWS co-sell / marketplace motion is available here.

Proposed incentives:
- Offer a 10% marketplace credit applied to their first 12 months if they sign the marketplace route by 11/20.
- Confirm with AWS PS that RetailCo qualifies for co-sell (I can loop in our AWS partner rep).

Operational asks for the call:
- Prepare a SKU-to-line-item mapping (use the attached worksheet).
- Prepare an example invoice and show how chargebacks will appear on RetailCo's bill.

I'll join the call if time permits; otherwise I will follow up after.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: aisha.morton@retailco.com
Cc: jason.lee@aws-partner.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Final: Marketplace billing path and revised quote — RetailCo

Hi Aisha — thanks for the call earlier.

Per our discussion:
- We've prepared a marketplace quote that mirrors your current committed pricing and includes a 10% first-year credit (as a marketplace promotion).
- Target switch date: 2026-11-30 (new Marketplace entitlement will be active and AWS billing will pick up charges starting with the next invoice cycle).
- DocuSign link below to accept the marketplace billing path; once signed we'll coordinate with AWS to enable entitlement.

Attachments: redwood-quote-retailco-marketplace.pdf (application/pdf)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-retailco

Please sign by 11/24 so we can meet the 11/30 activation window.

Thanks,
